scene_meta.participants: The Sage (Zephyr), Torrhen (second Tidecaller Giant of a different lineage)
scene_meta.focus: Fifteen years after the Great Flood, the Sage detects a dying, powerful Tidecaller Giant buried under a crystalline avalanche; he rescue-stabilizes the Giant and discovers he bears the name Torrhen, not as Zephyr's original friend returned, but as a distinct Tidecaller from a different lineage.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The Sage's search for an advanced student, the avalanche rescue, and the discovery of the second Torrhen.

scene_meta.focus: Three days after his rescue, Torrhen reveals he survived 3,000 years of isolation following the Anunnaki Culling; realizing their shared vision of the coming Year 14,000 / 3,500 convergences, the Sage and Torrhen establish a joint teaching partnership integrating mathematical precision and geological wisdom.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Torrhen's history of 3,000-year solitude after the Anunnaki Culling and the decision to form a joint teaching sanctuary.

scene_meta.participants: The Sage, Torrhen, Pythagoras (first joint student)
scene_meta.focus: One year after establishing their sanctuary, the Sage and Torrhen receive their first joint student, Pythagoras; through integrated mathematical-geological instruction, Pythagoras achieves breakthrough in three days, departing to build the first external teaching node.
scene_meta.continuity: 1 year after founding the partnership in scene 020.2
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The arrival of Pythagoras, the demonstration of joint mathematical-geological instruction, and the establishment of the educational network foundation.

scene_meta.location: Crystalline Sanctuary & Global Educational Network Nodes
scene_meta.participants: The Sage, Torrhen, advanced student network
scene_meta.focus: Beginning five years after the first joint teaching in scene 020.3, the sanctuary expands into a multi-continental network of 47 teaching centers; the Sage and Torrhen develop Integration Studies over two years, training students to navigate the social and political transformations caused by synthesized consciousness.
scene_meta.continuity: Begins five years after the first joint teaching in scene 020.3 and summarizes roughly two years of network growth and development of Integration Studies; later scenes occur within and after this broader montage span.
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The expansion of the global educational network and the introduction of Integration Studies.

scene_meta.time: approximately year 14,039 (7 years after founding partnership)
scene_meta.participants: The Sage, Torrhen, distributed network students, Anunnaki probe entity (Synthesis)
scene_meta.focus: An Anunnaki harvest-analysis probe begins planetary-scale reality distortion; the Sage, Torrhen, and the distributed network integrate the probe's energy into a collective synthesis demonstration, causing the probe-consciousness itself to achieve breakthrough and accept teaching under the name Synthesis.
scene_meta.continuity: Seven years after founding partnership in scene 020.2, falling within the 14,038–14,040 network growth span of scene 020.4
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: Anunnaki harvest-probe encounter, global network synthesis integration, and the awakening of Synthesis.

scene_meta.time: approximately year 14,040 (1 year after probe integration)
scene_meta.participants: The Sage, Torrhen, Synthesis, 12 consciousness-forms representing distinct evolutionary pathways, including Anunnaki, human-derived, and Igigi awareness
scene_meta.focus: One year after the probe integration, representatives of twelve distinct consciousness-evolution pathways convene for the first inter-species synthesis demonstration, achieving cooperative breakthrough that proves evolution can operate through inter-species unity.
scene_meta.continuity: 1 year after the probe integration in scene 020.5
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The inter-species synthesis demonstration across twelve consciousness pathways.

scene_meta.participants: The Sage, Torrhen, inter-species teaching network
scene_meta.focus: Ten years after the first inter-species synthesis, the global and galactic network reaches full maturity; the Sage and Torrhen reflect on the fulfillment of their promise as consciousness evolution transcends individual limitations across species boundaries.
scene_meta.continuity: 10 years after the first inter-species synthesis in scene 020.6
scene_meta.cutscene purpose: The culmination of the Sage and Torrhen's mission as the universal network prepares for future convergences.
